# GenCatalog

> Local AI image and video organizer for Grok Imagine, Higgsfield, and Digen. Captures prompts, metadata, and media automatically. Everything stored locally — nothing uploaded anywhere.

## What it does

GenCatalog saves AI-generated images and videos together with their full prompts, model settings, and metadata. One click from the Chrome extension captures everything.

- Browse, search, and filter your entire AI media library
- Full prompt and metadata preserved with every generation
- Supports Grok Imagine, Higgsfield, and Digen
- Color-coded source badges, star ratings, tags, notes, saved searches
- Sub-second grid load times even at 10,000+ items
- Compare mode: view two generations side by side
- Bulk operations: tag, move, or export dozens of items at once

## Pricing

$39 one-time purchase. Includes all v1 updates. 7-day free trial, no credit card required. Up to 100 items free.

## Privacy

Everything is stored locally on your machine. GenCatalog never uploads anything anywhere. No cloud, no accounts, no subscription.

## Requirements

- macOS or Windows 10/11
- Chrome browser (for the extension)
